details:
Mission X – Project Details

Project Overview:
Mission X is an interactive educational simulation designed to help students experience the challenges of managing a space mission on the Moon or Mars. Participants act as mission commanders, responsible for maintaining a stable base and ensuring crew survival.

Main Features:

  • Interactive space mission simulation.
  • Smart management of limited resources, including water, food, and energy.
  • Decision-making and problem-solving challenges.
  • Realistic emergencies, such as power failures, water shortages, and equipment malfunctions.
  • Performance tracking and feedback.

Project Objectives:

  • Develop critical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Introduce students to space exploration challenges.
  • Teach efficient resource management.
  • Transform theoretical space learning into practical experience.

Sustainability Impact:
Mission X demonstrates the importance of sustainable resource management through water conservation, energy efficiency, food production, and waste reduction.

Target Audience:
Students and young learners interested in space exploration, STEM education, and problem-solving.

Our Vision:
To make space education more interactive and practical, preparing the next generation to think, decide, and solve problems like real space mission commanders.
